**Overview:**  
Maju Jaya Management Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company incorporated on 1 Nov 2023, operating in the professional services sector in Pahang. It provides management consulting for small‑ and medium‑sized enterprises (PKS). The firm has five directors, with the largest shareholder owning 63.59 % of the equity and a share capital of RM 100,000. Financial data are limited to FY 2024, showing revenue of RM 10,153,873, a net loss, and an unqualified audit opinion.
